content.text:
They came from your existing processed DSE bank, not from anywhere else.

`build_radiation_pack.py` reads:

- metadata: `/Users/sinchunyeung/Documents/Materials/Phy/dse/processed/LQ/lq_questions.json`
- crops: `/Users/sinchunyeung/Documents/Materials/Phy/dse/processed/LQ/{year}/q{n}.png`

It keyword-classifies those Paper 1B LQs into the Ch.25 / Ch.27 radiation subtopics (with a few manual overrides). That’s why LQ coverage is thin - only years that already have cropped Paper 1B in that bank (roughly 2012–2023 + `ppp`).
